race.comment: STAPHANI (6) was so much better at Mornington than she had been this campaign. She came from near last to go under by a length. If she can get any sort of luck in the early stages, she is a very big hope of winning. STOLE HIM (7) went better last time riding the speed. He boxed on nicely and once again draws out so probably heads forward here too. LARRYOCTANE (9) is certainly going into this at peak fitness after a big prep. He came from a long way off them at Hamilton. Needs to repeat that. WOMEN IN UNIFORM (10) is ready to run her best race. She does love racing here having never missed the placings in four goes.
